profile.headline: Engineering at Ode
profile.summary:
Multi-zero-to-one engineering leader.

I love breaking down challenges and applying focused solutions through iteration, no matter the scope and complexity.

I enjoy driving effective technology choices and building teams that are proud of their impact and their organization.

I care about both the journey and the destination and getting us to the next level.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: → Fractional AI became Ode with Anthropic

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.description:
Making commerce on the internet easy, open, and programmatic. We built an agentic API to enable seamless transactions across multiple e-commerce marketplaces.

I led the engineering team and the API product through the next phase of AI-focused growth.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Improving access to surgical care by optimizing operating room utilization through AI/ML.

Very early stage. I led and strategized on all aspects of technology, data, and product.

positions.title: SVP of Engineering
positions.description:
Put together an exceptional core engineering team in a matter of months.

Laid the groundwork for a caring, open, and methodical builder team culture that will scale.

Built the first tooling to unlock visualization of medical practice costs, performance, and potential. Made all the initial infrastructure and architecture technical choices.

positions.title: Head of Mortgage Engineering
positions.description:
Continued to lead and grow the Engineering, Product, and Design as de-facto CTO for the Home Loans division post-acquisition.

In that period, we expanded to several states, and added new product lines, while enabling a more unified downstream experience for buyers who had started their HomeLight journey by getting matched to a great real estate agent.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
→ HomeLight acquired Eave.

Assumed the CTO role pre-acquisition. Took over technical evaluation and diligence, and prepared the team for successful partnership within the new wider org.

Also served as the interim head of the whole Engineering, Product, and Design team.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Very early hire, on the heels of the CTO. Built a custom, modern loan origination system from the ground up, bringing to life a complete rethinking of the mortgage process, making it more attuned and responsive to data, and more customer-focused.

Significant projects include automated transaction analysis, automated eligibility/affordability determination and decisioning, automated incorporation of data from OCR document sources, as well as significant contributions to the infrastructure and build/deploy flow.

Heavily involved in building the team.

positions.title: Founding Senior Platform Engineer - Core Insurance Systems Lead
positions.description:
Engineer #3. Laid a substantial foundation for tech and process/culture, as one of the original 4 lead engineers under the CTO.

Significant projects included the first telemedicine integration, building the broker enrollment system, automating regulatory and financial reporting, and leading the full suite of internal-facing apps as well as the first offshore engineering team at the company.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead engineer within an R&D game studio, collaborating with game designers, artists, and product managers to develop new games and manage social player activity at scale.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Part of a small team of architects building up expertise on and driving effective use of large-scale application and database server installations. Also focused on developer productivity and tooling.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - Tech Lead
positions.description: Led technology for the Player Services suite of applications, setting direction for 5 sub-products.

company.name: IGT, a subsidiary of International Game Technology PLC

positions.title: Lead Developer - Architect
positions.description: Developed an enterprise content management system from scratch, as part of a scrappy, fledgling startup.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Telecomm software consulting. Clients included RCN and AT&T Broadband. Architected hub/spoke middleware for billing and provisioning systems.
